run_eval_vjepa2: run the V-JEPA2 evaluation pipeline using a YAML config file and specified GPU devices
run_eval_val_only: run the V-JEPA2 evaluation in validation-only mode without training
run_eval_with_checkpoint: run the V-JEPA2 evaluation using a pretrained checkpoint and custom model name
run_eval_debugmode: run the V-JEPA2 evaluation in debug mode without spawning child processes
run_eval_fsdp: run the V-JEPA2 evaluation with FSDP distributed training across multiple GPUs
